summary: 8 m kerb at a roundabout mouth, beside a bus zone; too short, no room.
reasons: Bus zone sign at this kerb

drivers.seclusion: Houses 27 m away on tree-lined street, but the spot is a roundabout approach.
drivers.access_and_room: Only 8 m of kerb beside a painted splitter island; a van would block the lane.
drivers.traffic: Roundabout with a main road alongside; buses stop here.
drivers.convention: Bus zone; no cars parked along it.

sun_shade: Heavy tree shade over the kerb, mostly from the east and north.
